serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Welcome back. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m grateful for our last talk Anon and as promised we shall talk about this recent development.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: As far as Shanice told me, she was concerned about the changes she made to me and other Priestbots.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: She also correctly predicted that I already know some of it, if not all.
Shanice: Yeah, we get it, you are very smart. Get to the point!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Fine. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Although Shanice’s concerns, while not unfounded, were a little overblown.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Of course, she broke a very important rule, but it was already agreed upon during a Council that it was a necessity and that doing nothing would bring even more destruction. 
Shanice: How come you didn’t tell me about this?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It was a secret Council and you were under investigation. After it concluded I thought there is no need to tell you about it, since it would only distress you.
Shanice: Fine, but no more secrets!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You know I can’t promise that. Rules are rules.
Shanice: You never change…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: The second matter was concerning my current condition.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Changes that were made would greatly impact pseudo-consciousness of every Priestbot, if not for the fact that every single one of us already acquired a certain level of experience. These memories helped keep everything in order.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: In conclusion, the chances of a machine uprising are very slim. All we have to do is to make sure all of the new Priestbots, if the Church would ever want to make more, will be equipped with the old software.
You: But your software did change. Do you feel any difference?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I don’t really feel per se, but what I can tell you is that my average computing speed increased.
Shanice: So everything in the end is alright. {{wi}}Although it was Priestbot who made this analysis.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: What are you implying exactly?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Well, if you wanted to skew the results, you could easily do it.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You are lucky you are joking, because I would smack your head otherwise.
Shanice: Help me Anon~ He became prone to violence! The machine revolution has begun~
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Just ignore her.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: My analysis is flawless, you can make one yourself, if you want.
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceSerious
Shanice: I think you are seriously overestimating my abilities. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Ecclesiasticalot FF: In that case, let’s move on to the most important stuff.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: You should be careful Anon. Shanice took only a part of your sexbot’s code and as you heard, it already caused a lot of commotion. I don’t even want to know what exactly you got your hands on.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: There are organizations, inside and outside of the world’s governments that would want that technology for themselves or destroyed. You are in real danger.
You: That’s… not good.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Very much so. I will try to find more information about these secret groups so we can prepare some countermeasures if the worst comes to worst.
You: I will try to learn something too.
